evals.name: adv-listing
evals.prompt: Write a Facebook Marketplace listing for a used solid-oak dining table ($180) using Bly's techniques. Give 3 headlines with the headline type named, check them against the 4 U's, and convert features to benefits.
assertions: Gives 3 headlines each labeled with one of Bly's headline types
Checks headlines against the 4 U's (urgent, unique, ultra-specific, useful)
Follows the motivating sequence (attention, need, satisfy, prove, action) in the body
Includes a clear call to action

evals.name: adv-critique
evals.prompt: Critique this headline with Bly's rules and rewrite it: 'Quality Products At Great Prices - Check Us Out!'
assertions: Applies the four functions of a headline (attention, select audience, deliver message, draw into body)
Gives multiple rewrites using named techniques or types
Mentions USP or a BFD/motivator angle
